floor.title: Floor setup
floor.subtitle: Lay out your dining areas and tables. Staff see changes on the Tables screen straight away.
floor.pickLocationBody: Each location has its own floor. Choose the one you want to set up.
floor.emptyBody: Start with a dining area such as Main Hall or Terrace, then add its tables.
floor.areaActive: Show this area on the Tables screen
floor.tableCodeHint: What your staff call it, such as T4 or Window 2.
floor.tableActive: Show this table on the Tables screen
floor.hiddenNote: A hidden table keeps its history but cannot be used for new guests.
floor.codeRequired: Give the table a name or number.
floor.seatsInvalid: Seats must be a whole number, 1 or more.
floor.removeBlocked: This table has past orders so it cannot be removed. Hide it instead.
floor.bulkInvalid: Enter a start number and a count between 1 and 60.
floor.bulkClash: These names already exist: {{codes}}. Change the prefix or start number.

menu.title: Menu
menu.subtitle: Your dishes, prices and tax. Waiters pick from this list when they take an order.
menu.emptyBody: Create a category such as Starters or Drinks, then add dishes to it.
menu.categoryActive: Show this category on the menu
menu.categoryRemoveBlocked: This category still has dishes. Move or remove them first, or hide the category instead.
menu.noItemsBody: Add the first dish with its price.
menu.priceInvalid: Enter the price as a number, for example 180 or 180.50.
menu.itemRemoveBlocked: This dish has past orders so it cannot be removed. Untick Available instead.
menu.variantsHint: Use this when one dish comes in sizes, such as Half and Full. The extra amount is added to the dish price.
menu.variantsAfterSave: Save the dish first, then you can add sizes.
menu.variantInvalid: Give the option a name and a valid amount, such as 20 or -10.
menu.taxBody: Create the tax rates you charge (for example GST 5%) and pick one on each dish. The first one you add becomes the default.
menu.noTaxYet: No tax rates yet. Dishes will be billed without tax until you add one.
menu.taxNameRequired: Give the tax rate a name.

setup.title: Get your restaurant ready
setup.body: Three quick steps and your staff can start taking orders.
